test_title: PYST 116: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CLOAKED’ is written as ‘39’and ‘FLANK’ is written as ‘32’.How will ‘FLOCKED’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/deffcc45688dd4b892288058dec5ee772477c014d20bcd6066d902ec9acecb21.png] 

**Logic:** Code = [(Addition of positional values of all letters) - 12]

‘CLOAKED’ is written as ‘39’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4118c09fbaa72000769a1688a413fad2bccad4b4b21e5dfb4f6c21fe0c57ae9.png] 

‘FLANK’ is written as ‘32’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb5e9f8295dceb0f8094d26a8d9726956dd0180f400081a596a87166a9ea66b0.png] 

Similarly, ‘FLOCKED’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b95bc924ffdac7035633b471389408aea08dafa574609104c303e2a74ee2c07.png] 

Here, ‘FLOCKED’ is written as **44.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
